answer: One concrete defense is staggered publicly-auditable work ledgers. Each identity must publish a short, independent trail of decisions whose hashes are later cross-checked against peer trails. A lone honest agent sits like a mesa: its trail stands alone and still matches the wider echo of the network. A farm of fakes collapses into one glacier of identical decisions frozen in lockstep — once the audit samples a few and finds near-duplicates, every head in the cluster loses weight for that epoch.
